text:
Maya Rivera: Taking the evening primary now — I'm about to onboard the secondary and run through quick pointers. ping me if anything surprises you.
Alex Pohl: thanks — I'm on secondary until 23:30 PT. any hotspots from the afternoon?
Maya Rivera: traffic had a short KV-cache pressure window around 18:10. we fell back to model-variant B for ~7m. ops-bot recorded the fallback. no customer pages after that.
Sam T: saw a couple of TRACE-level spikes on the router — looks like a slow downstream db call that autoscaler didn't fully catch. restarted a single worker for warm cache; that helped.
Jess Lee: can you drop the runbook links here? the new engineer is on the call.
Maya Rivera: sure — main runbooks: 
- KV cache fallback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-fallback 
- Model variant fallback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallback 
- Router slowdowns: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/router-throttling
(ops-bot can also post the ticketed playbook)
incident-bot: Page created: INC-2026-2247 — KV cache pressure. Severity: P2. Assigned: Maya Rivera. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-2247
Alex Pohl: noted. quick checklist I usually run on handoff: 1) check incident bot for active pages 2) open /ops/dashboard for token latency 3) glance at recent deploys 4) confirm primary/secondary pager routing
Maya Rivera: adding a few quick commands for triage: 
```
# tail recent router logs for 5m
kubectl logs -n inference router-0 --since=5m | grep -E "WARN|ERROR" | tail -n 200

# check kv cache hit rate (prometheus)
curl -s "http://prom-querier/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_hit_rate" | jq .

# trigger a graceful restart of one worker (use for hot leaks)
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n inference --timeout=300s
```
Sam T: for model fallback confirmation: check /models/variants endpoint for active routing percentages. sample curl: `curl https://api.redwood/status/models/route`
Jess Lee: if customers are impacted, we escalate to support with the template below. saves time: 
```
Subject: [Incident INC-XXXX] Potential inference degradation — ETA 30m
Body: Summary, Affected endpoints, Mitigation in progress, Next steps, Contact oncall: @Maya Rivera
```
Maya Rivera: ops-bot, can you attach the most recent deployment diff between 17:00-19:00?
ops-bot: Attached: https://deploys.redwood/diffs/2026-03-14/17-00_to_19-00 — includes minor router config change (batcher tuning).
Alex Pohl: that batcher tuning looked safe in dev but might increase tail latency if traffic mixes long/short sequences. keep an eye on p95/p99.
Sam T: realtime tip — if tail latency climbs, toggle `batcher.max_tokens=4096` back to 2048 and watch p99 for 5m. command: `kubectl set env deploy/router BATCHER_MAX_TOKENS=2048 -n inference`
Maya Rivera: handoff note for secondary: Sam, you'll own immediate pages for KV/cache and router slowdowns from now until 23:30. Alex, you'll own escalation to oncall-ops if this crosses P1.
Sam T: got it. I'll scribble the quick remediations list: restart single worker -> flip batcher token -> check model routing -> open INC ticket -> notify support.
Jess Lee: also reminder: if model fallback happened, run the regression smoke set (link): https://evaluations.redwood/quick-smoke — run `python smoke.py --suite small` in infra-scripts.
Maya Rivera: thanks — couple more micro-pointers for new person: 
- Use `alert logic:kv_pressure` in Sentry to see correlated traces
- Prefix any CLI ops with a note in the incident thread (so actions are auditable)
- If you escalate, attach the `ops-dump` (s3://redwood-ops/dumps/<ts>)
Alex Pohl: one coverage gap: cross-zone failover test never completed during last maintenance. if we see a zone-level outage, fallback might be slower. filing a ticket to schedule the drill tomorrow.
Maya Rivera: added to my todo. linking ticket: https://tasks.redwood/PLT-893
incident-bot: Reminder: next scheduled oncall rotation swap at 23:30 PT.
Maya Rivera: final: I'm leaving primary now — Sam has primary duties, Alex is secondary. I'm reachable for 30m for questions. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
Sam T: thumbs up, taking it. I'll post a short update if anything changes.
Jess Lee: thanks all — leaving a tiny appendix in the thread for one-liners everyone can copy: 
- Restart single worker: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n inference`
- Toggle batcher tokens: `kubectl set env deploy/router BATCHER_MAX_TOKENS=2048 -n inference`
- Generate ops dump: `scripts/ops-dump --since 10m --out /tmp/dump.tar.gz && aws s3 cp /tmp/dump.tar.gz s3://redwood-ops/dumps/`
Maya Rivera: perfect. logging handoff in rota: https://rota.redwood/oncall/2026-03-14 — thanks everyone.
Alex Pohl: good handoff. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Handoff recorded for 2026-03-14 20:05 PT.
Sam T: closing thread for now, will reopen if we get pages.
Maya Rivera: thanks — night team, stay sharp. :coffee:
